<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative milestones:</strong> The Lok Sabha passed the Public Examinations Amendment Bill to curb paper leaks with stricter penalties, while the Rajya Sabha cleared a bill criminalizing insults to the national song &#x27;Vande Mataram&#x27;.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxPQmc4cDgxZjh6WlFDN1p0NWVqRXdQZXlZRmo0TmV4bTN0aTVYVnRoakdRcGszNGtzMmgyeXpSN0FlQWpEd3JtU2tsRUpteVdQREl2WnNhMXJTS0xibnRUOUtzRDJ0d25JRlptUlJZWnROV2Z0aGFSODR3dzZ2MTVvTjlTdkZPREROVENB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a></span></li>

</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>
